We have just passed the palm tree. It has stood there since 2002 and was never alive: every leaf is fibreglass and resin on a steel core. The trunk was built in California and shipped in via Los Angeles, Houston and Gdynia. The artist put it there so that someone would finally hear the name Jerusalem Avenue and ask where Warsaw’s Jews had gone. We will come back to that question further north.
